```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  var m = (window.location.hash || '').match(/#page=(\d+)/);
  if (m) {
    var iframe = document.querySelector('iframe[src*=".pdf"]');
    if (iframe) {
      var base = iframe.getAttribute('src').replace(/#.*$/, '');
      iframe.setAttribute('src', base + '#page=' + m[1]);
    }
  }
});
</script>
<iframe src="../pdfs/DP Music Subject Guide.pdf"
        width="100%"
        style="height:85vh; border:1px solid #e0d6c8; border-radius:4px;">
</iframe>
```
